end.summary:
Identified earthworm, ant, and beetle as soil animals.
Discussed that damp places may have more small animals.
Suggested observing damp leaves or soil with a stick without touching.
Earthworm’s role in soil was misunderstood and not corrected before the lesson ended.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming soil animals and using a safe observation method: look with a stick and avoid touching. They shared the idea that earthworms spoil soil; this mix-up was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, an adult can help Pihu observe damp soil or leaves and talk about how earthworms help make soil healthier.
